summary: D1 makes the corpus runner fail any scenario whose declared initial_state.fixture_override keys no binding read, so honoring an override and proving it become the same act; D2 fails a binding that reads a key the scenario never declared, guarding the contract in both directions; D3 keeps fixture_override free-form in the schema because closing the key set would have admitted the defect, whose keys were spelled correctly and simply unread; D4 deletes AJ6-compact-terminal-work's two override keys as false rather than implementing them, since compaction_required names no field in the system and canonical_home_project asserts proj-api against a resolver that returns proj-web. AJ5's binding now reads its two keys and checks the fold replay implements what they state.
title: A scenario override is honored by its binding or it is not in the corpus
